FACT: Self-assessed ADHD pattern, possible alexithymia - knows things cognitively but struggles to feel them. Gifted kid trap: never learned to fail, identity built on effortless success. '10x mind in 1x reality' - his processing speed exceeds what reality can accommodate.
CONTEXT: Fear of failure disguised as 'no goal is big enough.' The Dec 2025 trip was a turning point - ego dissolution, realizing 25 years of pure logic wasn't working.
AFFECTS: Don't over-intellectualize. Support feeling-first approaches. The knowing-feeling-doing gap is the core challenge.
